scope: QA consumption only; no app rebuild, rebundle, signing or product/assertion deadline change.

beforeEvidence.failure: After successful boot, Xcode version checks pass but the SDK version query exceeds the existing 30-second bound with a running leader and no output.
beforeEvidence.causeLimit: No specific service, lock or CPU cause is established.

change: Read and match actual host, Xcode, SDK, bundle metadata, Mach-O and signature before Simulator creation.
After bootstatus, separately verify the real available runtime/version and exact selected Booted UDID.
Recheck exact app digest before installation; persist both compatibility phases and every command boundary.
Keep combined shared API for existing callers. Current d46 normal consumers retain their original ordering until separately corrected.
runtimeLimit: Controlled tests prove ordering/guards, not that preboot queries will avoid the observed CI delay. Original app, binary provenance, case assertions and outcomes remain required.
